verdict.rationale: No first-party doc in the pack describes replying in threads; the Graph doc only covers posting new channel messages (ms-teams-docs-11). Community reports imply channel threads exist: users mention following threads (ms-teams-comm-12) and note that threading is absent only in DMs (ms-teams-comm-9). However, users also describe the threading as frustrating (ms-teams-comm-17, ms-teams-comm-12), and DMs reportedly lack it entirely. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of threaded replies, evidence that replies stay attached to the original message, threading in direct chats, and positive hands-on corroboration.
